title: Site Reliability Engineer Advanced Roadmap
summary: A step‑by‑step plan to deepen SRE expertise, build a showcase portfolio, and prepare for senior‑level roles. Focuses on leadership, advanced observability, and interview readiness.

phases.title: Foundations Refresh
phases.summary: Reinforce core Linux, networking, and programming fundamentals.

milestones.title: Linux System Mastery
milestones.outcome: Can configure, troubleshoot, and secure Linux servers autonomously.

tasks.title: Read Linux Filesystem Hierarchy
tasks.description: Study the FHS section of the official Linux Documentation Project.

tasks.title: Configure SELinux in Enforcing Mode
tasks.description: Enable SELinux on a VM, set policies, and verify with audit logs.

tasks.title: Create a Bash Script for Log Rotation
tasks.description: Write and test a script that rotates and compresses logs daily.

tasks.title: Reflect on Common Pitfalls
tasks.description: Write a short note on three frequent Linux admin mistakes you’ve seen.

milestones.title: Networking Essentials
milestones.outcome: Can design, debug, and secure network paths for services.

tasks.title: Watch TCP/IP Basics on freeCodeCamp
tasks.description: Complete the 30‑minute video covering IP, TCP, and UDP fundamentals.

tasks.title: Set Up iptables Firewall Rules
tasks.description: Create inbound/outbound rules for a test service and verify with nmap.

tasks.title: Trace Packet Flow with traceroute
tasks.description: Run traceroute between two VMs and document each hop.

tasks.title: Connect with a SRE Community
tasks.description: Join the #sre channel on the CNCF Slack and introduce yourself.

milestones.title: Programming for Automation
milestones.outcome: Can write reliable scripts and small services in Go or Python.

tasks.title: Read Go Concurrency Patterns on Go Blog
tasks.description: Study the official blog post on goroutine patterns (30 min).

tasks.title: Implement a Health‑Check Endpoint in Go
tasks.description: Write a simple HTTP server that returns 200 OK and unit‑test it.

tasks.title: Refactor a Python Script to Use argparse
tasks.description: Add command‑line parsing to an existing automation script.

tasks.title: Reflect on Code Readability
tasks.description: List three improvements you made and why they matter for reliability.

phases.title: Core SRE Skills
phases.summary: Develop expertise in observability, incident response, and service level objectives.

milestones.title: Observability Stack
milestones.outcome: Can deploy, query, and alert on metrics, logs, and traces.

tasks.title: Read Prometheus Architecture on docs.prometheus.io
tasks.description: Skim the architecture overview (20 min).

tasks.title: Deploy Prometheus & Grafana via Docker Compose
tasks.description: Set up a local stack and verify metric collection from a sample app.

tasks.title: Create a Log Pipeline with Loki
tasks.description: Configure Loki to ingest Docker logs and visualize in Grafana.

tasks.title: Write an Alert Rule for CPU Saturation
tasks.description: Define a Prometheus alert and test its firing condition.

tasks.title: Connect with Observability Experts
tasks.description: Attend a free webinar on OpenTelemetry hosted by CNCF.

milestones.title: Incident Management Process
milestones.outcome: Can lead an incident from detection through post‑mortem.

tasks.title: Read Google SRE Incident Guide (PDF)
tasks.description: Read the incident response chapter (30 min).

tasks.title: Simulate an Outage in a Test Cluster
tasks.description: Kill a service, trigger alerts, and run a mock incident call.

tasks.title: Draft an Incident Timeline Template
tasks.description: Create a markdown template for timestamps, actions, and owners.

tasks.title: Conduct a 15‑minute Post‑mortem Review
tasks.description: Write a brief post‑mortem for the simulated outage and share with a peer.

tasks.title: Reflect on Communication Gaps
tasks.description: Note two communication improvements for future incidents.

milestones.title: Service Level Objectives
milestones.outcome: Can define, measure, and report SLOs and error budgets.

tasks.title: Read SLO Chapter in Google SRE Book
tasks.description: Focus on error‑budget policies (25 min).

tasks.title: Define an SLO for Latency on Sample Service
tasks.description: Set a 99.9 % 95th‑percentile latency target and calculate error budget.

tasks.title: Build a Dashboard Showing Error‑Budget Burn
tasks.description: Use Grafana to visualize remaining budget over time.

tasks.title: Connect with SLO Practitioners
tasks.description: Post a question about SLO trade‑offs on the SRE subreddit.

tasks.title: Reflect on SLO Choice Rationale
tasks.description: Write a short note why the chosen latency target fits business goals.

phases.title: Proof of Work
phases.summary: Create portfolio projects that demonstrate end‑to‑end reliability engineering.

milestones.title: Monitoring Stack with Alerts
milestones.outcome: A reproducible repo showing metrics collection, dashboards, and alerting for a microservice.

tasks.title: Clone the Starter Repo from GitHub
tasks.description: Fork a minimal microservice repo to your account.

tasks.title: Add Prometheus Exporters
tasks.description: Instrument the service with CPU, memory, and request metrics.

tasks.title: Configure Alert Rules for 5‑minute Downtime
tasks.description: Create alerts for service unavailability and test them.

tasks.title: Write a README with Setup Steps
tasks.description: Document installation, configuration, and alert verification.

tasks.title: Reflect on What Could Fail
tasks.description: List three failure modes not covered by current alerts.

milestones.title: Load Test and Capacity Report
milestones.outcome: A report and scripts that show how to size resources for traffic spikes.

tasks.title: Read k6 Getting Started Guide
tasks.description: Follow the official k6 tutorial to install and run a basic test (30 min).

tasks.title: Write a k6 Script for Peak Load
tasks.description: Simulate 10 k requests per second for 5 minutes against the service.

tasks.title: Collect CPU/Memory Metrics During Test
tasks.description: Use Prometheus to capture resource usage while the load runs.

tasks.title: Generate a Capacity Planning Document
tasks.description: Summarize findings, recommend instance sizes, and include graphs.

tasks.title: Connect with Capacity Engineers
tasks.description: Message a senior SRE on LinkedIn for feedback on your report.

milestones.title: Simulated Outage Postmortem
milestones.outcome: A polished postmortem that follows industry best practices and includes actionable improvements.

tasks.title: Design a Failure Scenario Script
tasks.description: Create a bash script that randomly kills a pod and logs timestamps (40 min).

tasks.title: Run the Scenario and Capture Alerts
tasks.description: Execute the script, record alert timings, and collect logs.

tasks.title: Write a Structured Postmortem
tasks.description: Use the template from the Incident Management milestone to document root cause and remediation.

tasks.title: Peer Review the Postmortem
tasks.description: Share with a colleague and incorporate their suggestions.

tasks.title: Reflect on Learning Outcomes
tasks.description: Note two personal takeaways that will change your future incident response.

phases.title: Getting Ready
phases.summary: Advance leadership, deep dive into distributed systems, and prepare for senior interviews.

milestones.title: Distributed Systems Deep Dive
milestones.outcome: Can explain consensus, replication, and failure handling in large‑scale services.

tasks.title: Read CAP Theorem Article on ACM
tasks.description: Summarize the three guarantees and trade‑offs (25 min).

tasks.title: Implement a Simple Raft Leader Election in Go
tasks.description: Code a minimal Raft node that elects a leader among three instances.

tasks.title: Run a Fault Injection Test
tasks.description: Kill the leader node and observe re‑election, noting logs.

tasks.title: Connect with Distributed Systems Researchers
tasks.description: Attend a free virtual talk from the MIT CSAIL SRE series.

tasks.title: Reflect on Consistency Choices
tasks.description: Write a brief note on when you’d favor strong vs eventual consistency.

milestones.title: Leadership & Mentoring
milestones.outcome: Can coach junior engineers and drive reliability initiatives.

tasks.title: Read “Team Topologies” Chapter on Enabling Teams
tasks.description: Focus on the enabling team pattern (30 min).

tasks.title: Create a 30‑Minute Workshop Outline
tasks.description: Design a hands‑on session on writing effective runbooks.

tasks.title: Facilitate the Workshop with a Peer
tasks.description: Run the session, gather feedback, and iterate.

tasks.title: Connect with a Senior SRE Mentor
tasks.description: Schedule a 30‑minute coffee chat via a professional network.

tasks.title: Reflect on Coaching Style
tasks.description: Write three strengths and two areas to improve as a mentor.

milestones.title: Senior Interview Prep
milestones.outcome: Can confidently answer system design, troubleshooting, and behavioral questions for SRE roles.

tasks.title: Study System Design Primer on educative.io (free preview)
tasks.description: Review scalability, sharding, and caching concepts (35 min).

tasks.title: Solve Three SRE Coding Challenges on LeetCode
tasks.description: Focus on algorithms relevant to log parsing and metric aggregation.

tasks.title: Mock Incident Response Interview
tasks.description: Pair with a peer to run a timed incident scenario and debrief.

tasks.title: Update Portfolio README with Impact Metrics
tasks.description: Add bullet points showing latency reduction, cost savings, and uptime improvements.

tasks.title: Reflect on Interview Performance
tasks.description: Note three answers that felt strong and two that need polishing.
